entries.name: xray-core
entries.notes: Track wyx2685/Xray-core main commits and keep the replace pinned to an exact commit.

entries.name: sing-box
entries.notes: V2bX-flavoured sing-box fork; upstream sing-box has no live AddUsers/DelUsers inbound API. Its dev-next branch has not moved since 2025-12-02. Bumping this pin requires re-checking github.com/sagernet/{sing,sing-quic,quic-go} against xray-core — see docs/sing-box.md.

entries.name: sing-quic
entries.notes: Pinned: newest sing-quic that still builds against a sing version without tls.Config.HandshakeTimeout, which xray-core requires. Do not bump without reading docs/sing-box.md.

entries.name: sing-quic-go
entries.notes: Pinned: oldest sing-box quic-go that uses the qpack v0.6 API, so it can share github.com/quic-go/qpack with the apernet/quic-go that xray-core needs.
